insurer: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured + Booster+ Sum Insured + Safeguard/Safeguard+ Sum Insured (as per plan/Policy Schedule)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: “We don’t limit your choice. Choose the room you like, but choose judiciously to protect your Sum Insured.”
great.explanation: No room rent limit is stated, so you can choose any room category. This helps avoid room-rent linked deductions and reduces the chance of out-of-pocket costs.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: “ReAssure “Forever”: Enjoy unlimited Sum Insured. The first paid claim in the life of the policy triggers ReAssure “Forever”. Once Triggered it stays for life, provided that the policy is renewed without break.”
great.explanation: After the first paid claim, ReAssure “Forever” gets triggered and then stays for life with continuous renewal, giving “unlimited Sum Insured”. This can significantly improve long-term protection for repeat or high-value claims.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered up to 180 days after discharge. This supports follow-up consultations, medicines, and tests during recovery.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: “Home Care Treatment means treatment availed by the insured person at home which in normal course would require care and treatment at a hospital but is actually taken at home...”
good.explanation: Home care treatment is covered when the condition would normally require hospital treatment but is taken at home. This helps in situations where hospitalization is not feasible or beds are unavailable.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first Policy.”
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are not covered for the first 36 months of continuous coverage. Claims related to declared/undeclared PEDs can be rejected until this waiting period is completed.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: “...excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage...”
good.explanation: Specified diseases/procedures are not covered for 24 months of continuous coverage. This delays coverage for listed conditions even if they are not pre-existing.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: “Expenses related to the treatment of any Illness within 30 days from the first Policy commencement date shall be excluded...”
good.explanation: Illness-related claims are excluded for the first 30 days from the first policy commencement date. This means only eligible non-illness claims (typically accidents) are payable during this period.

good.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: “...for 60 days before the date of admission...”
good.explanation: Medical expenses are covered up to 60 days before the date of admission. This reduces out-of-pocket costs for diagnostics and consultations leading up to hospitalization.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: “Air Ambulance: Only in case of Emergency. Maximum INR 2,50,000 per hospitalization.”
good.explanation: Emergency air ambulance is covered up to ₹2,50,000 per hospitalization. This can be valuable for critical transfers, but costs beyond the limit will be payable by you.

good.name: Modern Treatments
good.quote: “We pay for Modern treatments as specified below: 1. Uterine Artery Embolization and HIFU... 7. Robotic surgeries ...”
good.explanation: Modern treatments are covered as per the specified list in the policy wording. Coverage is limited to listed procedures, so unlisted advanced treatments may not be payable.

bad.name: Deductible
bad.quote: “This is an aggregate amount in a year... which we will NOT pay. Once the total expense exceeds this amount, balance we will pay.”
bad.explanation: An annual aggregate deductible applies, meaning you must pay claims yourself until the deductible is crossed in that year. This can materially increase your out-of-pocket costs, especially for smaller or mid-sized claims.

unclear.name: Consumables
unclear.quote: “Claim Safeguard: We will cover non-payable items mentioned in ‘List I – Expenses not covered’ of Annexure I’.”
unclear.explanation: Non-payable items from Annexure I (List I) are covered under Claim Safeguard. Whether this is included by default or only if you opt for Safeguard/Safeguard+ is not clear from the extracted text.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: “Cashless claim facility is available at our network hospitals ONLY... for the latest list, refer to our website www.nivabupa.com.”
unclear.explanation: Cashless treatment is available only at the insurer’s network hospitals, with the list hosted on the website. The policy wording here does not state the number of network hospitals, so network size cannot be benchmarked.

unclear.name: Booster Benefit
unclear.quote: “Maximum it will accumulate up to 3/5/10 times (based on the plan you have chosen) of the Base Sum Insured.”
unclear.explanation: Booster+ can accumulate up to 3x/5x/10x of Base Sum Insured depending on the plan chosen. The exact cap applicable to you cannot be confirmed without the plan variant details.

disclaimer: Standard IRDAI exclusions apply. Please verify all details with your insurer or policy document.
